salt_pct.quote: **Salt content – 1.45 g of salt per 100 g of cheese = 1.45%**

ammonia.reason: Ammonia from amino acid deamination by raw-milk nonstarter lactobacilli during 34-48 mo proteolysis.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol and indole from Tyr/Trp catabolism by wild raw-milk flora and alpine pasture feed.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from rennet and plasmin proteolysis, mostly trimmed by lactobacilli peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; trace methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from FFA beta-oxidation only.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and high free amino acids during heating of low-moisture aged curd.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by starter, faded with age, plus C4-C12 lactones from milk fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic, hexanoic and isovaleric acids from lipoprotein lipase and raw-milk esterase lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: Very low moisture 23.7% and firm cooked-pressed matrix limits fat-coated creamy mouthfeel despite 50% FDM.

crumbliness.reason: Low MFFB and tyrosine/calcium lactate crystals from extensive proteolysis and moisture loss fracture the paste.

firmness.reason: Cooked, pressed, extra-hard texture with 23.7% moisture and high calcium-bound paracasein crosslinking.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from Phe Strecker degradation plus pasture-derived terpenes.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol by nonstarter flora.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only; slight caprylic/capric sharpness from lipolysis, no goat-specific branched-chain acids.

malty_nutty.reason: 2-/3-methylbutanal and pyrazines from Leu/Ile Strecker reaction plus propionibacteria during long alpine ripening.

melt.reason: Rennet-cooked paracasein still flows on heating but reduced by very low moisture and high proteolysis.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid lipoxygenase, minimal in cooked interior with no surface mold.

oil_off.reason: Free oil release from coalesced fat globules in high-fat 38.4% low-moisture matrix on heating.

smoky.reason: Not smoked; only faint guaiacol possible from traditional spruce-wood copper-vat heating, not absorbed.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic plus acetic/propanoic acids from Streptococcus thermophilus and propionic fermentation.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata acid-stretching; rennet-cooked curd melts to flow, not to aligned fibrous stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol/H2S from Met/Cys catabolism by lactobacilli plus initial cooked-curd whey protein denaturation.

sweet.reason: Sweet amino acids proline/glycine and glycerol from lipolysis, no residual lactose after long aging.

umami.reason: High free glutamate from extensive chymosin/plasmin and peptidase proteolysis over 34+ months.
